title: Held inputs are released when the page stops listening; the gunship is thermal only, its contact squares are gone, and 7 8 9 0 take the seats
context: Owner playtest of the V1 session (docs/STATE.md, priority 1) returned four notes. (1) The plasma thrower stuck on auto-fire with a repeated clicking cue, triggered by taking a screenshot: focus leaves the document, the keyup for a held trigger never lands, and the game keeps holding it; the not-ready voice behind it then retriggers every frame. Only 'blur' was handled, and only for the five drive keys (src/td-tab.js) and the seat's own trigger (src/sentry-pilot.js) - a window can keep focus while the input stops arriving. (2) The gunship seat opened in thermal but M cycled it to night and normal, so FLIR was a mode rather than the seat's identity. (3) A small square sat over each enemy. (4) Switching between TANK, GUNSHIP, SOL-82 and MAP had no intuitive keys.
outcome: src/core/held-input.js rules on the four events that mean the page lost the input (blur; visibilitychange when HIDDEN; pointerlockchange when a lock we HAD is gone; mouseleave of the canvas) and drops every held flag; src/td-tab.js and src/sentry-pilot.js both release on all four, the tank clearing all seven keys instead of five and the seat clearing its trigger and turn. src/core/cue-gate.js floors each cue name so a flickering hold cannot turn the `ready`/`stop` edges into a stream of clicks (src/weapon-voice.js); a round actually leaving the barrel clears the floor, so a real burst still announces its end while a stuck trigger, which fires nothing, stays quiet. The gunship optic is thermal and nothing else: the MODES cycle, the M handler, the seat footer's offer and the dead .gunship-night CSS are gone, and the GROUND TRUTH / IMPACT monitor and the radar keep their true colour. The squares were the optic's contact markers - one screen-sized white point per living enemy, depthTest off, drawn over everything (src/fx/gunship-optic.js) - and are removed outright along with contactsStyle(); the lock reticle the owner keeps is a different thing, the sentry optic's centred SVG box in src/fx/story-scope.js, untouched. 7 8 9 0 are TANK, GUNSHIP, SOL-82 and MAP: a capture-phase handler registered before any seat installs its own clicks the views strip's matching button, so a seat that is not available yet refuses exactly as the button does, the existing keys still work, and src/fx/controls-card.js teaches the four. src/td-tab.js stayed at exactly its 13506-line budget (net 0).
alternatives: Handle only 'blur', as before: rejected - the screenshot case can leave the window focused while the keyup is delivered elsewhere, which is the reported bug.

Gate the repeated cue inside src/audio.js for every sample: rejected - the floor is a presentation decision about weapon edges, not a property of the mixer, and a global gate would swallow legitimately dense fire.

Key the cue gate by role (ready vs stop) rather than by sample name: rejected - the Rotor's stop and ready are the same sample, so a flicker would still alternate two gated roles and buzz at twice the floor.
Keep the gunship's view switch but default it to thermal: rejected by the owner's note - FLIR is the seat's visual identity, 'no switch'.

Scope the contact markers to the seat's map view instead of removing them: rejected - they are one square per enemy wherever they are drawn, which is exactly what the owner asked to remove; the Quiver's lock box is a separate, centred reticle and was already scoped to the optic.
evidence: npm test: 118 test programs passed, including the new test/held-input.mjs (four release events, hidden/lock edges, every held flag dropped once) and test/cue-gate.mjs (first cue speaks, a flickering trigger cannot buzz, names independent, reset re-arms).

test/trigger-sequence.mjs caught the first cut of the gate swallowing the Rotor's stop cue (expected ['minigun_ready','sentry_rotor','minigun_ready'], got two); reset-on-shot fixed it and the test passes unchanged.
npm run check: architecture 85 pure-layer modules checked, game/lab controller boundaries, line budgets and top-level placement hold; src/td-tab.js 13506 lines against its 13506 budget (net 0).
